supersedes.reason: The first lock did not freeze survivorship-safe archive discovery, scalable preparation, resumable checkpoints, or automatic compute expansion. No archive, development outcome, or confirmation outcome was opened under v1.

userConstraints: BTC and ETH are mandatory members of every eligible basket
Use public or free historical data before requesting paid acquisition
Directional price prediction is the primary research objective
This phase must not wait for future wall-clock observations
Compute expands automatically only through preregistered development gates
Return after dispatch and a healthy first checkpoint so a lighter model can supervise
designConventions: Prior thirty-day notional ranks assets only to bound liquidity and data quality
Basket sizes and horizons are bounded search dimensions rather than presumed optima
Forecast evidence is evaluated before execution or portfolio claims
Every attempted configuration remains in the immutable trial ledger
Current exchange metadata never supplies the historical research universe
Engineering throughput measurements cannot rank or promote predictive candidates
empiricalClaims: BTC may or may not improve forecasts beyond alternative market factors
Divergence may continue, reverse, or contain no stable information
No estimator family or forecast horizon is presumed superior
A richer information set may fail to improve the strongest market-only baseline

source.missingObjectPolicy: quarantine; never interpret as zero activity, inactivity, or delisting
source.availabilitySemantics: exchange close time plus one millisecond; retrospective availability proxy

universePolicy.selection: rank complete, causally available daily USDT perpetual observations; acquire five-minute bars only after taking the union of all selected venue symbols

searchBudget.budgetUnit: one exact model configuration and seed; every fold-level fit is counted inside the trial ledger entry

breadth.coverage: each family sees every horizon once, both targets, and every factor representation before elimination

iterativeSearch.sampling: when a rung has maximumRows, retain eight equal-duration chronological blocks spaced across the complete development period; preserve every basket member and consecutive five-minute row inside each block
iterativeSearch.checkpointPolicy: write one immutable trial and model bundle before scheduling the next trial; resume only after hash verification

validation.method: purged chronological expanding-window development scoring followed by one untouched single-use family confirmation
validation.multiplicity: Holm over the complete frozen confirmation family

developmentPeriod.purpose: archive-backed purged development scoring and bounded selection

confirmation.purpose: sealed archive confirmation with sufficient coverage for the seven-day horizon

allowed: restart the exact frozen service after a transient interruption
